faq.q: How do I start using OZ-POS for free?
faq.a: Download OZ-POS and launch it — the free plan starts immediately, no signup required.
Yes. Every feature works offline and syncs to the cloud when the connection returns.

faq.q: How do I activate my license key?
faq.a: Open Settings → License, enter your key, and activate. The key binds to your device hardware.

faq.q: Where can I report a bug?
faq.a: Email us at support@ozpos.my.id with your version number and a description of what happened.

items.title: Offline-First
items.description: Sales, checkout, and inventory keep working 100% without internet. Never lose a sale or halt checkout during outages.

items.title: No Hardware Barrier
items.description: Built on a state-of-the-art tech stack (lean Rust & embedded SQLite) for extreme efficiency. Runs blazing fast on budget tablets, laptops, and legacy POS hardware.

items.title: Multi-Store & Multi-Terminal
items.description: Manage multiple branch locations, cashier registers, and backroom warehouses in one unified topology with seamless sync.

items.title: Advanced Reports & Analytics
items.description: Deep insights into sales velocity, top-performing items, rush-hour peak times, and net profit margins across shifts.

items.title: E-Wallets & Native QRIS
items.description: Accept dynamic QRIS and digital wallet payments directly on screen with instant verification and zero extra hardware fees.

items.title: Debit & Credit Card
items.description: Seamless EDC and payment gateway integrations for chip, contactless tap, and swipe card transactions.

items.title: Whitelabel
items.description: Full branding control over receipts, business logos, and print layouts available on Premium, without needing a custom Enterprise contract.

items.title: Lua Scripting
items.description: Embedded Lua engine for limitless flexibility: tiered discounts, happy-hour promos, BOGO deals, and custom tax rules.

items.title: Full Audit Logging & Shift
items.description: Tamper-evident audit trail for every cash drawer event, line void, manager override, and shift reconciliation.
